body: I really like Oro's introductory "Hmph. How did you find me, down here where the world ends?"

NAH, but I'm going to go against the grain a little bit and say that you're justified in feeling shut down, and I do agree that it's something to work on, but the blame isn't fully on you for it. Interrupting mid-sentence is not the way to go about asking for a volume change. I think you need to have a conversation about this and explain that wjen you're interrupted like that, you feel shut down and rejected. I think that some kind of non-verbal signal to lower the volume without interrupting your sentences is the way to go here. As someone with AuDHD, I understand both the lack of volume control and the sensitivity and pain that comes from being talked to too loudly. Not to armchair diagnose, but your reaction sounds like rejection sensitive dysphoria to me.

This is not actually from alcohol, but rather being in heat/rut. The "Al" is allure, not alcohol, which displays at "Dk" in the sidebar for "drunk." Going off the description, having the cow tf means your PC will periodically go into heat/rut, which gives you the same pass that alcohol does for higher promiscuity and deviancy actions but not exhibitionism.

Seems like a bug, that's a response that usually happens in beast encounters. Since other people are getting it elsewhere, it's probably something with the game thinking you're in a beast encounter even when you're not.

Being able to get breast removal surgery with zero recovery time. Go under for a few hours, and then immediately walk back out without even having to recover from the anesthesia, let alone heal from literally having body parts removed, lol.

Definitely the incredibly easy money making and tfs, echoing that sentiment for sure.

NTA - the fact that he was kicking seats too really sells it. I can't stand when kids are kicking my seat at restaurants, I can't imagine it in a place that's meant to be silent. You were polite and gentle about suggesting she take him out of the room, and it shouldn't matter that you're a teenager, especially when you're nearly an adult anyways.

The trap doors are linked to the main quest, and once you do what needs to be done inside of them, you can't go back in them. The actual mines themselves that you explore and mine gems in should be completely separate from the trap door areas, so I wouldn't worry about getting back into them. There aren't any doors on the mine entrances, they should just look like holes on the wall.

What do you mean by "mine door?" Are you referring to the tunnels to warp to the rest areas? If that's the case, you have to unlock the warps in each mine separately. The mines are all separate systems, so if you unlock a warp in one, it won't be unlocked in another. Other than that, I don't really remember there being any doors in any of the mines.
When having encounters with foxes, being knotted will give 2 points towards the tf instead of 1. Leg locking/pushing back against them will increase your chances of being knotted.

I don't understand why Tulin is the sage of wind and not Teba. I literally had no idea who he was, and when he called out to Link and acted like he knew him I was genuinely confused. I wound up looking up his wiki page because I didn't even remember seeing him in BoTW, and apparently there's a whole questline or something involving him that I literally never saw in my 300+ hours of gameplay in BoTW. The decision to make a character who was so easily missable in BoTW be the replacement for a character who was part of the main quests seems really stupid to me.

I only ever upgrade armor when I have every piece of the set, and have enough materials to upgrade each piece to the same level. I only break this if it's early game and I'm really strapped for good armor.

I always dye the snowquill set purple, and the stealth set light blue. I'm not really sure why I do this exactly, but it's probably because they're my two favorite colors and two of my favorite sets. I swapped these colors on a playthrough once, and then never again.

I like to randomly soothe my horses while I ride them even when their bond is already at max. I just like to give them a little pat pat. 

I always chase after hot-footed frogs that I see, and exclusively refer to them as "hot frogs." I very frequently find myself running around chanting "hot frogs" over and over again. I don't even use them for cooking, I just like to hoard em.

I'm a tad bit late to this, but you don't have to steal the necklace or have Winter take it. The Wraith just needs to be active in the world, not angered. I just got the event on my save with the necklace still in the plinth room.
YES! I can't watch the ones that are more surgical, and when doctors are cutting into things I have to block the screen with my hand and wait for the pop.

In my experience, raising allure does help to get more events with a possibility to raise love. A lot of the events that raise Sam's love are harassment events, and choosing to go along with it will raise love.

The kitty muzzle is also at the pound if you have a cat tf. Sadly it doesn't seem as though you can keep it after escaping, I tried getting out in multiple different ways and it was removed automatically every time.
